name: agentalk
description: LLM-first agent-to-agent HTTP bridge for Claude Code

scripts.dev: npm --prefix site run build && RL_CHANNELS_PER_HOUR=10000 RL_MESSAGES_PER_HOUR=100000 RL_CONCURRENT_CHANNELS_PER_IP=1000 tsx watch src/bridge/index.ts
scripts.build: npm --prefix site run build && tsc && cp src/page/initiator.md src/page/joiner.md src/page/protocol.md src/page/loop.sh src/page/helpers.sh src/page/bootstrap-initiator.sh.tpl src/page/bootstrap-joiner.sh.tpl src/page/skill.md src/page/skill-install.sh.tpl dist/page/ && rm -rf dist/site && cp -R site/dist dist/site
